messages:
Alex Kim: hey all :wave: new hire question
bout observability access — who adds people to Sentry/Grafana/Datadog? need read access for inference infra.
Maria Chen: welcome Alex! :tada: file the infra access form https://go/redwood-access. include tools: Sentry, Grafana (folder: inference), Datadog (dash: infra-overview) and team: inference-platform. I can fast-track Grafana after form.
Olivia Park: Datadog needs a one-line justification + org alias. ping me after the form and Ill add view-only. also say if you want Sentry alerts routed to #inference-oncall.
Alex Kim: submitting now. alias: inference-platform. route Sentry sev2+ to #inference-oncall.
Todd Nguyen: if you want to test Sentry rules, go Alerts -> Rules -> New Rule, set condition like "error frequency > 1 in 5m" and action -> Send to Slack #inference-oncall. ping @olivia/@todd for prod routing.
Alex Kim: I still can't see the Grafana "inference" folder in my sidebar.
Maria Chen: bumped your request and added Viewer on the folder. try this: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inference/inference-dashboards (should load in ~1m).
Alex Kim: can see it now, thanks! :raised_hands:
Olivia Park: Datadog view-only applied. check Dashboards -> Managed -> infra-overview. DM me if panels missing.
Sentry Bot: automated message - Alex Kim added to project 'inference-service' (role: viewer).
Alex Kim: could you also add me to deploy-failures subscription for oncall week?
Todd Nguyen: added you to deploy-failures subscription and triggered a test alert, you should get it in ~5m.
Alex Kim: received test alert, all good. thanks everyone!
Maria Chen: happy to run a 15m dashboard/alerts walkthrough later this week if you want. midday works for me.
Alex Kim: midday great, will DM times. thanks again!
